## Your question

to the specific file or skill if you can (`AGENTS.md`, `GETTING-STARTED.md`,
a skill under `.claude/skills/`, a steering doc).

## Notes

This is a template for a private life OS, so please describe your situation
in general terms rather than pasting real entries from `your-life/`. If an
example would help, use fabricated content or point to the shape of what's
in `examples/`.
